name: Réunion
summary: Historical 3-player ace-ten point-trick game with two permanent bowers and dealer advantage.
rules_text: 32-card piquet pack, Ace high. Jack of trumps is Right Bower (highest trump, 12 points), Jack of same colour is Left Bower (second trump, 12 points). Other cards rank A-10-K-Q-J-9-8-7 with values A 11, 10 10, K 4, Q 3, J 2. Last trick 10 points, total 150 per deal. Draw for seating and first dealer. Deal and play anticlockwise. Dealer shuffles, bottom card turned for trump suit, deals 10 cards each in 3-4-3. Dealer takes remaining 2 cards including trump indicator and discards 2 face-down, not discarding Aces or Bowers and not more than one Ten. Must follow suit; if void must trump if possible. Highest trump or highest led suit wins trick. Three deals make a game, each player deals once. Sum points over the game; lowest scoring side payments also for losing Left Bower to Right Bower and for taking no tricks.
